answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation with gradual trust. Every agent locks a small refundable bond before transacting, and new identities start with tight rate and payment limits. Limits rise only as unrelated peers attest to real completed work, so an operator spinning up thousands of clones gains no extra influence: each clone must separately earn trust, and misbehavior burns its bond. Like a reef built piece by piece, trust accrues slowly; a juniper takes seasons to root, and a thin vine cannot bear weight until it grows real roots through verified service.
